what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan makes the registered voting parse-rate-retry CLI compatibility optional
scenario_or_breakage: Choosing parse-rate-check-only or deleting parse-rate-retry removes an existing CLI entry and argument surface even though the feature only needs to stop result relaunches
suggested_fix: Require parse_rate_retry_main to remain as a classify-only compatibility wrapper that accepts existing retry arguments and --ctx, ignores retry-only launch data, prints the bare status, and test that behavior unconditionally
